name: zcliprect_clip_poly_no_uv
description: zClipRect::ClipPoly_NoUV clips polygon vertices against enabled XY bounds without UV or attribute payloads.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification through the zcliprect_clip_poly_no_uv target still fails after replacing the shared ClipPolyNoUvCore wrapper with a direct local-loop body: 1424 unmasked mismatches, 112 relocation bytes masked, 14 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, Binary Ninja body 1577 bytes, VC object symbol 1408 bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x47cdc0 validates clipping g_Clip_PolyVerts against enabled x-min, x-max, y-min, and y-max planes with local scratch-buffer ping-pong storage, interpolating generated XY edge vertices and returning zero when fewer than three vertices remain.
The native smoke verifies all enabled XY edge clipping keeps output vertices inside the target bounds and verifies rejection when the polygon is clipped away.
